title: 85 lawyers including 11 women conferred Senior Advocate designation by Delhi High Court: Read list
description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday conferred the Senior Advocate designation on 85 lawyers. Eleven of these are women.As reported by Bar & Bench earlier, the decision was taken at a full court meeting held this evening. A total of 231 candidates had applied for the gown.
